categories.main_business_segments: Exelixis operates as a single business segment focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of oncology therapeutics. Its primary commercial products are CABOMETYX (cabozantinib) and COMETRIQ (cabozantinib), with additional out-licensed products COTELLIC (cobimetinib) and MINNEBRO (esaxerenone). The company’s activities span drug discovery, clinical development, and global commercialization, primarily in cancer treatment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Exelixis leverages expertise in small molecule drug discovery, antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), and biotherapeutics. Its flagship molecule, cabozantinib, is a multi-kinase inhibitor developed through proprietary research. The company relies on third-party contract manufacturers for production, adhering to GMP standards, and utilizes advanced bioconjugation and antibody engineering platforms through collaborations for next-generation therapeutics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company’s primary customers are specialty distributors, specialty pharmacies, and, through them, oncologists and healthcare providers treating cancer patients. Exelixis targets major oncology indications such as renal cell carcinoma (RCC), hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC), and medullary thyroid cancer (MTC), with a focus on both first-line and previously treated patient populations.
categories.geographic_coverage: Exelixis markets its products primarily in the United States, with significant international presence through partners Ipsen (Europe, rest of world excluding Japan and US) and Takeda (Japan). CABOMETYX is approved in 62 countries, including the EU, UK, Canada, Japan, Brazil, Taiwan, South Korea, and Australia, reflecting broad global reach.
categories.supply_chain_position: Exelixis operates downstream in the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on late-stage development, commercialization, and marketing of finished oncology therapeutics. Manufacturing and distribution are outsourced to third-party contract organizations, while the company manages product development, regulatory affairs, and commercial operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on expanding the cabozantinib franchise into new indications and combinations, advancing a diversified pipeline of small molecules and biotherapeutics (including ADCs), and leveraging strategic partnerships for innovation. R&D priorities include next-generation kinase inhibitors (e.g., zanzalintinib), novel ADCs (e.g., XB002), and in-licensing promising assets, with significant investment in both internal discovery and external collaborations.
categories.revenue_model: Exelixis generates revenue primarily through product sales of CABOMETYX and COMETRIQ in the US, royalties and milestones from international partners (Ipsen and Takeda), and profit-sharing or royalties from out-licensed products (e.g., COTELLIC). Additional revenue streams include development cost reimbursements, milestone payments, and product supply services under collaboration agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Exelixis competes with major pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies in the oncology space, including Merck, Pfizer, Bristol-Myers Squibb, Roche, Bayer, Eisai, and Eli Lilly. CABOMETYX faces competition from other targeted therapies and immuno-oncology combinations in RCC, HCC, and DTC. The company is recognized as a leading innovator in multi-kinase inhibition and is a key player in the evolving landscape of targeted and combination cancer therapies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Exelixis reported $1.61 billion in total revenues, with $1.4 billion from net product sales, reflecting 30% year-over-year growth in product revenues. The company has maintained annual profitability for six consecutive years and ended 2022 with $2.1 billion in cash and investments. R&D and SG&A expenses are increasing in line with pipeline expansion and commercial growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Exelixis emphasizes clinically differentiated, next-generation oncology therapies that address unmet medical needs and improve patient outcomes. CABOMETYX is positioned as a standard of care in advanced RCC and a key option in HCC and DTC, supported by robust clinical data and broad regulatory approvals. The company’s pipeline leverages innovative modalities (e.g., ADCs, bispecific antibodies) and strategic partnerships to deliver novel, effective cancer treatments.
